structured.statement: y = 1.0 1, standard uncertainty 1.7 1; 95% coverage interval [-1.7, 5.3] 1 (Monte Carlo, 200000 draws). The first-order GUM interval differs by more than the numerical tolerance and should not be used for this model.
assumptions: The model is exactly the supplied expression; unlisted influences and definitional uncertainty are not included.
Inputs are independent unless a correlation is declared; correlations are supported between normal inputs only.
normal: standard_uncertainty is the standard deviation. uniform and triangular: half_width is the half-width of a symmetric distribution centred on value.
The first-order coverage factor comes from the normal distribution; no Welch–Satterthwaite effective degrees of freedom are applied.
Numeric literals are dimensionless. Affine temperature units (°C, °F) are refused; use K.
The Monte Carlo interval is probabilistically symmetric; the shortest interval is reported separately.
structured.method: First-order GUM propagation (JCGM 100:2008) with exact forward-mode derivatives; Monte Carlo propagation (JCGM 101:2008) with SplitMix64, Box–Muller and 10 independently seeded blocks; JCGM 101 §8 validation of the first-order interval; block spread checked against the 2-significant-digit numerical tolerance.
